subject: sw-18: Graph interaction keyboard spec for Kai
body:
## Graph Interaction Keyboard Spec

Date: 2026-02-24
Filed by: GD
Ref: WCAG 2.1.1 (keyboard accessible)

### Problem

MCM exam questions with graphs (Chart.js) are currently read-only visual aids. Kai reads the graph and enters a numeric answer in the text input. The graph canvas element itself does not need to be keyboard-interactive since Kai is not required to click on it.

However: WCAG 2.1.1 requires that if any information is conveyed ONLY via the graph (not in the question text), the graph must have a keyboard-accessible alternative.

This spec defines the accessible alternative pattern for graph questions.

### Current State

Chart.js renders to `<canvas>`. Canvas elements have `role='img'` and `aria-label` in current implementation (per sw-03 chart accessibility spec, already shipped). This satisfies WCAG 2.1.1 via text alternative, NOT keyboard interaction.

### Determination

After reviewing MCM graph questions: all graph information is ALSO conveyed in the question text (the question describes the relationship, the graph visually confirms it). Therefore:

**WCAG 2.1.1 is satisfied by aria-label text alternative alone.**

Keyboard interaction on the graph canvas is NOT required.

### What IS Required

1. The `<canvas>` element must have `tabindex='0'` to be focusable
2. When focused, pressing Enter or Space should announce the aria-label text via aria-live
3. The focus ring must be visible (2px, --accent-focus-ring color)

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All graph `<canvas>` elements have `tabindex='0'`
- [ ] All graph `<canvas>` elements have `role='img'`
- [ ] All graph `<canvas>` elements have descriptive `aria-label` (already done per sw-03)
- [ ] On Enter/Space keypress while canvas is focused: announce aria-label text via aria-live='assertive'
- [ ] Focus ring: 2px solid var(--accent-focus-ring) with 2px offset
- [ ] Focus ring visible in both light and dark mode

### What NOT to Change

- Chart.js configuration (GI owns data, GD owns layout/color only)
- The question text or answer input fields (separate from this spec)
- Any behavior when Kai clicks/taps the graph (no change)

### Scope

File: exam.html (canvas element attributes + keypress handler)
CSS: Focus ring for canvas (use existing --accent-focus-ring token if present, else --accent-blue-on-dark #4A90D9)

### Low Priority

This is a WCAG enhancement (currently passing via aria-label). Implement after higher-priority features.
